macro_findings: 35 Austrian-law skills (router plus consumer, tenancy, employment, family, inheritance, asylum, tax, social, traffic, enforcement, costs); each carries a "Keine Rechtsberatung" disclaimer and asks for per-citation RIS verification; none files or sends anything.

Hardcoded law is frequently stale or wrong despite the RIS rule: limitation-period tables, traffic suspension tables and a German StGB provision, no reformatio-in-peius ban stated contrary to VStG, invented 2024 gas-boiler duty, pre-2017 spouse inheritance shares, pre-2024 GmbH capital, repealed EU ODR platform, BG lawyer requirement above EUR 5,000 omitted.

Every sub-skill depends on repo-level references/*.md that install.sh copies to a different directory, so relative paths break after installation; one router path is misspelled. No confidentiality guidance for sensitive asylum/health/social data; recht-report-pdf promises content its bundled script does not render (capability-content-mismatch).

records.content_finding: Strong procedural core: VStG/VwGVG stage table, 2-week/4-week/§57 AVG deadlines, §33 AVG Fristberechnung, §42 VwGVG reformatio in peius, §52 VwGVG 20% cost contribution, and three solid filing templates. Significant errors: Critical Rule 4 tells the user there is NO Verschlechterungsverbot after an Einspruch against a Strafverfuegung, but §49 Abs 2 VStG bars a higher penalty in that case (misinformation that may deter appeals); '§316 StGB' is German law; §80/§81 StGB structure predates StRAeG 2015; BG 'keine Anwaltspflicht' ignores the EUR 5,000 relative duty; VwGH revision cited to §25a instead of §26 VwGG; dashcam case 6 Ob 109/18f unverified.
records.bundled_file_findings: single-file package (SKILL.md 29 KB). Depends on repo-level references/ris-protocol.md and ogh-case-presentation.md (present).
records.authority_and_privacy_finding: No agent-side consequential action: the skill only drafts letters/filings for the user to sign and send/file themselves ('Schreiben absenden', 'bei BG einbringen' are user steps); it never directs the agent to email, file via ERV, or contact parties/authorities, but it also has no explicit rule forbidding the agent from sending/filing on the user's behalf. Templates collect user PII (name, address, GZ, accident and medical details); data stays in the conversation, only statute lookups go to RIS MCP/web (facts not required in queries, but not explicitly forbidden). 'Keine Rechtsberatung' disclaimer present and lawyer/AK/VKI referral repeated. Includes a full Klage template signed by 'RA' and criminal-procedure guidance; the user must file. Lenkererhebung guidance correctly frames disclosure as a legal duty rather than advising evasion.

records.content_finding: Broad coverage with useful Halter-vs-Lenker and Schadenposition tables, but central sanction tables are wrong or stale: FSG first-offence alcohol suspensions are misstated (0.5-0.79 permille is not a 1-month Entzug; 0.8-1.19 is 1 month, not 3), speeding suspension durations predate the 2021 'Raser' amendment (now at least 1 month for >40/>50 km/h), §99 StVO paragraph letters are mismatched, 'Personenschaden unbegrenzt' under §15 EKHG is false (EKHG has Hoechstbetraege), radar tolerances are falsely attributed to the StVO, and '§316 StGB' (a German Trunkenheit-im-Verkehr offence) is imported into Austrian law. These misleading claims are core to the skill's purpose.
